posts.author: Bharat
posts.text: Jio IPO and Akash Ambani’s bigger tech ambitions beyond telecom — 5G consume lot of data even if you just check internet speed so everyone has to give unlimited data on 5G plans. Before 5G, in US you still only get 1 GB data per month on 4G plans and in India we are getting 1 GB per day on 4G. if there were no jio no one would have thought about giving these much data with only 150 to 300 rupees. everyone was charging per GB not unlimited data with 1 GB per day high speed with restrictions. Its like how zerodha introduced flat fee per order.

posts.text: Jio IPO and Akash Ambani’s bigger tech ambitions beyond telecom — Would it not have happened without Jio? 4G was coming anyway and competition would’ve reduced prices anyway.
